reason: No release artifact of AutoVersion is consumed: Stado builds it from a pinned git revision (stado-rs/Cargo.toml, autoversion rev), and an adopting repository builds the binary from a checkout of a tag (README, Adopting it). Its version is the git tag (Cargo.toml carries none), and released-surface.json /version is the baseline its own rule compares against, frozen at the published v0.1.0; read as a release version it named every release 0.1.0, and a raised release version written into it would break that baseline.
